title: End-of-Series Grand Arbiter Verdict Modal displaying Series Outcome, Strategic Rating (`S-RANK: GRAND GEOMETER` to `C-RANK: INITIATE`), Win/Deadlock/Loss breakdown, Top-5 Observatory Ledger, and `[SPACE]` New Series / `[C]` Reconfigure Protocol.
summary: Implement the End-of-Series Grand Arbiter Verdict Modal with dynamic rank calculations, session ledger recording, and keyboard-driven lifecycle transitions.
technical_specification: When `state.stats.seriesOver === true`, lock matrix input and render a high-contrast modal anchored at `(400, 310)`. Derive strategic score from efficiency ratio `E = (wins * 3 + deadlocks) / max(1, roundsPlayed * 3)`: assign `S-RANK: GRAND GEOMETER` for `E >= 0.85`, `A-RANK: CELESTIAL ARCHITECT` for `E >= 0.65`, `B-RANK: SECTOR ADEPT` for `E >= 0.45`, else `C-RANK: INITIATE`. Append record `{ wins, losses, deadlocks, rank, score: Math.round(E * 1000) }` into `state.stats.observatoryLedger` (capped to top 5 descending). If `state.keys['Space']`, trigger `SERIES_RESET` to clear grid and counters; if `state.keys['KeyC']`, toggle `state.stats.configOpen = true`.
acceptance_criteria: Modal renders only when state.stats.seriesOver is true without obstructing underlying collinear vectors.
Pressing Space initiates a new series and resets bout tallies while preserving the top-5 ledger.
Strategic rank recalculates deterministically based on win/deadlock efficiency formula.
